## EMST role: Environmental health specialist (state variant, entry level; P2)

*Match:* `skos:closeMatch`, confidence 0.7, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R26-environmental-health-specialist/state:2583`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (agent draft)**

- Investigate outbreaks, complaints and emerging environmental health hazards to control exposure — entry L1
- Conduct environmental public health inspections and plan reviews — entry L1 *(distinguishing)*
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — entry L1
- Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination — entry L1
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — entry L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1
- Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments — entry L1

**Main tasks at this level (indicative % of time, agent draft)**

- Collect food, water and environmental samples during an outbreak investigation following chain-of-custody and laboratory submission requirements — 8.1% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Identify contributing factors of a foodborne outbreak from interviews with an implicated establishment's staff and review of its records — 8.1% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Inspect a retail food establishment for foodborne illness risk factors, ranking violations by public-health risk and recording required corrections — 7.1% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Inspect a public swimming pool's water chemistry, circulation and safety equipment, closing the pool when an imminent health hazard exists — 6.5% *(needed at entry)*
- Survey larval and adult mosquito populations at fixed and complaint sites following the vector programme's trapping protocol — 6.5% *(needed at entry)*
- Investigate a reported environmental violation, establishing the facts, responsible party and applicable requirement before recommending an enforcement response — 6.5% *(needed at entry)*
- Assemble the evidence file for an enforcement case, linking each alleged violation to the inspection findings, records and samples that prove it — 6.5% *(needed at entry)*
- Change sampling location, order or method on site when a likely contamination source is found, recording the source and the change — 6.5% *(needed at entry)*
- Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check — 6.5% *(needed at entry)*
- Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them — 6.5% *(needed at entry)*
- Answer public questions about an uncertain environmental risk at a meeting or by phone using the current message map — 6.5% *(needed at entry)*
- Map heat vulnerability across a jurisdiction from temperature, health, housing and population data to target cooling resources and outreach — 4.9%

*Credential gates (draft):* State registered sanitarian / environmental health specialist license (required); Registered Environmental Health Specialist / Registered Sanitarian (REHS/RS) (preferred)
